name: Jere R. Behrman
notes: No personal homepage; only CV available is a Word document dated Sept 2021 (items after 2021 missing; CV points to a Penn PSC publications database not used). Very long CV (~490 published items, ~360 unpublished papers): per rules included all items from 2005 onward (journal articles, chapters, books, unpublished working papers not later listed as published) plus pre-2005 journal articles; pre-2005 chapters, books, reports and mimeos omitted. Entries were parsed semi-automatically from the CV text: titles are verbatim, venues are the CV citation text, co-author names as written in the CV (a few may appear in "Last, First" fragments), and author lists without "with" in the CV contain only Behrman. Comments, reviews, technical reports without titles in quotes excluded. No abstracts.
